question: What kinds of grains may be used as offerings in this ritual?
premises: Unbroken rice grains may be used.
Divine grains born from rice are included.
Other very beautiful grains may also be used.
inference: Therefore, offerings may be made with unbroken rice grains, divine rice grains, or other very beautiful grains.
plain_english: With unbroken rice grains, with divine grains born from rice, or with other very beautiful ones.
